Preserve the exact character, pose silhouette, head, face pointing RIGHT, tank top, arms, hands and pixel-art shading style. CHANGE ONLY which leg is foreground vs background. The current art incorrectly puts the bright NEAR leg in front of the body. The leg reaching BACKWARD to the LEFT must be the NEAR leg, bright skin, attached to the foreground shorts opening, its thigh drawn OVER and occluding the far thigh at the groin. Keep body proportions, framing, contact/flight position. Source used on 64x64 logical frames, 1024x1024 texture cell, body 34 logical pixels high, anchored foot baseline44, nearest sampling.
